data.description: Everything you enter is saved in this browser and loads automatically — no account, no password, nothing sent to a server. Export a file to back it up or move it to another machine.

storage.title: Stored in this browser
storage.empty: Nothing saved yet — data you add in any section shows up here.

export.title: Export
export.description: Save every section's data to a single SQLite (.db) file — open it in a SQLite browser to inspect or edit it directly, or just keep it as a backup.

import.title: Import
import.description: Load a previously exported file. It replaces the data currently in this browser.

reset.title: Clear this browser's data
reset.description: Deletes everything stored here. Export first if you want to keep it.

importDialog.title: Replace existing data?
importDialog.description: Importing permanently deletes all data currently in this browser and replaces it with the file's contents.

resetDialog.title: Delete all data in this browser?
resetDialog.description: This permanently removes every record from every section. It cannot be undone.

errors.title: Something's not right
errors.malformedFile: This file isn't a valid Personal Management export.

about.heading: About
about.description: A personal management tool to track, update, and stay on top of day-to-day life — obligations, notes, plans, spending, and investments. Local-first: your data stays in your browser, never a server.
